description: State of the Community Report for Beaumont-Port Arthur, Texas Metropolitan Area: 2020 Population and Economic Technical Report is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Nathanael Rosenheim, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). This state of the community report provides information to guide planning projects that best serve the community of the Beaumont-Port Arthur (BPA) Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) in Texas. The primary counties in the MSA are Hardin County, Jefferson County, and Orange County. There are three major places in the MSA, Beaumont, Port Arthur, and Orange. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-scgy-jg80. Keywords: Demographics, Economics, population projections, SOC, TAMU, HRRC. Published 2023-01-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
